Question 2
?

Given the hyperboloid of one sheet x26+y22−(z+1)23=1, find the domain of z=z(x,y).

a
{(x,y):x26+y22<1}
b
The entire xy-plane
c
{(x,y):x26+y22≥1}
d
{(x,y):x26−y22≥0}
e
{(x,y):x26−y22<0}
